İçerikler yeterli, olması gereken konular var. Ama dersin neredeyse ilk 1.5 ay boyunca sadece prob / algebra / optimization review yapıldı. Kesinlikle yapılması lazım, ama yani iki matrix'in de nasıl çarpıldığını da anlatmasına gerek yok gibi geliyor bana hocanın. Daha az zaman ayrılabilirdi / ya da gerçekten daha dersin diğer kalan kısmında kullanılacak trickerin, öğrenciler tarafından en çok karıştırılabiliecek noktaların olduğu şeyler anlatılabilirdi.

The course is well structured and provides strong coverage of neural networks. The quizzes feel more like midterms, but the instructor is fair and does not ask extremely difficult questions, so the evaluation feels balanced. The course is also well designed for graduate students: it gives a solid understanding of each topic and lets students go deeper based on their own research interests, rather than focusing too heavily on projects and homework.

There are still some parts that could be improved. The first five weeks were spent on very basic topics. While they helped build a foundation, it felt like too much time was dedicated to them, especially since the more advanced and important neural network topics started later in the semester. When those topics began, four homework assignments were given in four weeks during the busiest time of the semester. This workload could be distributed more evenly.

Another point is related to homework difficulty in the current AI era. Since tools like ChatGPT exist, very challenging homework often leads students to rely on them instead of completing the work independently. Designing assignments that are still meaningful but more manageable might help more students truly engage and learn on their own.

Overall, if you want to build a strong understanding of neural networks, this course with Omer Hoca is one of the best options.
